title: Terms of Service
description: The terms that govern use of the Monk Mantra website and our marketing and software services.
html:
1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing and using Monk Mantra's website and services, you accept and agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

2. Services Overview

Monk Mantra provides marketing and software services to businesses in India, with a dedicated practice for doctors, clinics, hospitals and diagnostic centres, including local search and Google Business Profile management, search engine optimisation, paid search, content, reputation management, analytics and reporting, website development, and custom software such as booking, WhatsApp automation and CRM. The specific scope, fees and timelines of any engagement are set out in a written proposal or agreement, which prevails over these terms where they differ.

3. Client Responsibilities

As a client, you agree to:

  • Provide accurate and complete information about your business
  • Grant necessary access to marketing platforms and accounts
  • Respond to requests for information in a timely manner
  • Review and approve campaign materials when required
  • Make payments according to agreed terms
  • Comply with all applicable laws and regulations
  • Maintain the confidentiality of login credentials

4. Payment Terms

Payment terms are specified in individual service agreements. General terms include:

  • Monthly retainer fees are due at the beginning of each month
  • Project-based payments are due according to milestone schedules
  • Late payments may incur additional fees
  • Refunds are subject to our refund policy
  • Price changes require 30 days notice

5. Intellectual Property

Intellectual property rights are allocated as follows:

  • Client retains ownership of their brand, trademarks, and proprietary content
  • Monk Mantra retains ownership of proprietary methods, tools, and processes
  • Marketing materials created become client property upon full payment
  • Monk Mantra may use campaign results for case studies (with client approval)
  • Third-party tools and platforms are governed by their respective terms

6. Confidentiality

We maintain strict confidentiality regarding client information, business strategies, and campaign data. This confidentiality obligation continues beyond the termination of our service agreement.

7. Performance and Results

While we strive for excellent results, marketing outcomes depend on various factors:

  • We cannot guarantee specific results or ROI
  • Performance may vary based on market conditions
  • Client cooperation affects campaign success
  • Regular reporting provides transparency on performance
  • Strategies may require adjustment based on results

8. Termination

Service agreements may be terminated:

  • By either party with 30 days written notice
  • Immediately for breach of contract
  • Immediately for non-payment after notice period
  • Upon completion of project-based work

Upon termination, client retains access to completed work and receives final reports within 30 days.

9. Limitation of Liability

Monk Mantra's liability is limited to the amount paid for services in the 12 months preceding any claim. We are not liable for indirect, consequential, or punitive damages, including lost profits or business interruption.

10. Force Majeure

Neither party shall be liable for delays or failures in performance due to circumstances beyond their reasonable control, including natural disasters, government actions, or technical failures of third-party platforms.

11. Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of [Your Jurisdiction]. Any disputes will be resolved through binding arbitration or in the courts of [Your Jurisdiction].

12. Changes to Terms

We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Material changes will be communicated to active clients with 30 days notice. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of updated terms.
